# Criterion Bids

> Tender drafting support for UK SMEs bidding on public sector contracts.

Criterion Bids provides structured, submission-ready quality response drafts aligned to evaluation criteria. The service is designed for small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) in the cleaning, facilities management, and soft FM sectors who need professional tender drafts without full bid management or consultancy fees.

## Services

- Drafting structured quality responses aligned to tender evaluation criteria
- Providing clear, professional first-draft answers for public sector tenders
- Maintaining consistent tone and formatting across all responses
- Written communication throughout for clarity and efficiency

## Who This Is For

- Cleaning and facilities management providers
- Soft FM and operational service suppliers (catering, security, waste)
- SMEs bidding for UK public sector contracts

## Out of Scope

Criterion does not offer pricing or commercial strategy, bid submission or portal uploads, guarantees of award or scoring outcomes, or full bid consultancy and advisory services. Clients retain responsibility for factual accuracy and final submission.

## Pricing

Typical drafting support: £350–£750 per tender. Fees confirmed after reviewing tender documents. Urgent/priority requests handled where availability allows.

## Process

1. Client sends tender documents and confirms submission deadline
2. Scope reviewed and drafting fee confirmed
3. Invoice issued
4. Drafting begins on receipt of payment and company information
5. Structured draft responses delivered for client review and submission
